name: CodeAgent
description: Plan, scaffold, browse, run, save and email JavaScript projects from natural language descriptions. Uses local knowledge base when available.

functions.name: getProjectStatus
functions.description: Get the current coding session project status and file list
functions.output_format: JSON listing of project files and current session state

workflows.name: scaffold_project
workflows.description: Plan and scaffold a complete JavaScript project from a natural language description, using the local knowledge base for framework-specific code

required_params.name: project_description
required_params.description: Describe what the project should do, what framework it uses, and what features it needs.

optional_params.name: project_name
optional_params.description: What should I name the project folder?

workflows.name: run_code
workflows.description: Run the current project's entry point in a sandboxed Node.js process and stream output

optional_params.name: entry_file
optional_params.description: Which file to run? (defaults to index.js)

workflows.name: save_project
workflows.description: Save the current project from temp storage to a permanent location on disk

optional_params.name: save_path
optional_params.description: Where should I save it? (absolute path, defaults to ~/btw-projects/{project_name})

workflows.name: email_project
workflows.description: Zip the current project and send it as a Gmail attachment

required_params.name: recipient
required_params.description: Who should I send it to? (name or email address)

optional_params.name: message
optional_params.description: What message should accompany the code?
